title: 屋外の地形
theme: mountain valley landscape in rural Japan, realistic photographic ground materials

cells.name: 草原
cells.prompt: lush green meadow grass with some taller blades and small clover, seen from directly above, about 2 m across

cells.name: 岩壁
cells.prompt: steep weathered grey andesite cliff face with fractures, ledges and patches of moss, seen straight on, about 4 m across

cells.name: 川の水
cells.prompt: flowing clear green mountain river water seen from above with ripples, white riffles and stones visible below, about 3 m across

cells.name: 川原の砂
cells.prompt: pale grey riverbank sand with scattered small pebbles and drift lines, seen from directly above, about 2 m across

cells.name: 山道
cells.prompt: narrow packed earth mountain trail with exposed tree roots, small stones and fallen needles, seen from directly above, about 1.5 m across

cells.name: 水田
cells.prompt: flooded rice paddy seen from above with neat rows of young green rice seedlings in still muddy water reflecting the sky, about 3 m across

cells.name: 茶畑
cells.prompt: top view of a Japanese tea plantation with neatly trimmed rounded rows of bright green tea bushes, rows running left to right, about 2 m across

cells.name: ガレ場
cells.prompt: loose grey scree slope of angular broken rocks of many sizes, seen from above, about 2 m across

cells.name: 耕した畑
cells.prompt: freshly ploughed dark brown field soil in straight furrows, furrows running left to right, seen from directly above, about 2 m across
